label: ERW forecast

methods.what: the method chosen for the place by the rule of the method note (the lowest mean absolute error of the ERW's methods over the last two years of the backtest)
the operator's own day-ahead demand forecast, as filed on Form EIA-930 (eia930_forecast_error_hourly, the screened hours left out); for the price none is published, and its rows are held
the same local hour of the latest whole day held when the forecast is made (two days before the target day, for the day-ahead forecast)
the same local hour seven days before the target day
the least-squares regression of the method note, one a local hour, refit for every day on the 730 days before it
the same regression with three more recent regressors (the last hour of the latest day read, the same hour the day before it, the same hour two weeks before the target day); added in session 10601

separate_lines.with_weather_known: the regression with the region's observed temperature added: it reads the target day's own weather, so it is not a forecast and never the ERW forecast; scored apart (series demand_weather_known, cuts all and last_2_years) on the hours its weather is held, beside the regression and the operator on the same hours

separate_lines_added.with_weather_forecast: series demand_weather_forecast (session 10602): the regression with the airport's observed temperature in the fit and the NWS forecast as issued by 20:00 UTC the day before in the forecast; scored only on the days such a forecast is held, never the ERW forecast (method note section 19)
separate_lines_added.net_demand: series net_demand (session 10602): the demand less wind and solar; for this series the column mape holds the mean absolute error over the mean net demand of the same hours, in percent (method note section 20)

cuts_added.operator_sound: demand: the hours of the months whose operator filing passes the filing check (the filed forecast within 5 percent of the demand over the month; method note section 18)
cuts_added.operator_sound_last_2_years: the same, over the last 730 days
cuts_added.with_operator: net demand: the hours where the operator's demand, wind and solar forecasts are all held

metrics.mae: mean absolute error, in the series' unit
metrics.mape: mean absolute percent error, in percent

mape_rule: Demand: every hour scored (demand is always above zero). Price: only hours whose actual price is at least 5 USD/MWh in size; a percent of a price near zero means nothing, and the cell is null when no hour qualifies.

cuts.all: every hour of the backtest held by every method
cuts.last_2_years: the last 730 days of the backtest (the days the method is chosen on)
cuts.hour: key 0 to 23, the place's clock, over the last two years
cuts.top10: the place's ten highest-demand days of the backtest (by the day's peak hour)
cuts.spike: price only: the hours above the grid's 99th percentile
